from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1) if row_bounds[i + 1] > row_bounds[i] + 1]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1) if col_bounds[i + 1] > col_bounds[i] + 1]
    sep_values = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_spans for r in range(r0, r1) for c0, c1 in col_spans for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in sep_values)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            marked = sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] not in sep_values for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            out_row.append(1 if marked >= 2 else 5)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
'''
